title: Decoder floors, case (b): the six remaining d = 8 multisets of #2816 are dead (≥ 64 with ≤ 3 non-full corrections; E8 lifts ≥ 67; no κ claim)
body:
Follow-up to #2816 (ours), which left exactly six `d = 8` weight multisets of the weight-≤ 7 basis open: `[7^5,6^5,1]`, `[7^6,6^4]`, `[7^8,5,4,1]`, `[7^8,5,5]`, `[7^8,6,3,1]`, `[7^8,6,4]`. All six are impossible. Adds only `research/one-sided-six-multisets/`; nothing existing changes.

**Results** (setting, normalisation and `n_nf` as in #2816; P112, case (b), every `m`, char 0)
- **Basis Lemma (PROVEN).** At `d = 8` the fundamental circuits of any λ-basis give 8 *linearly independent* codeword directions `h_y` with `Off(h_y) ⊆ U_B ∪ Λ(F_y)`.
- **Lemma S66 / S66+t (CHECKED, two independent implementations).** For any two 6-dimensional label flats (plus one free line, chosen per direction, for S66+t) the qualifying directions span at most 3 dimensions (at most 6 directions). `s66.c` (C) and `indep.py` (Python, other coordinates and labels, direction list rebuilt from orthogonal root sums and checked against the theta counts) agree on all 159 orbit representatives of `V_1` against all 776,805 line sets of `V_2`; `indep.py` runs in 6 chunks and `check_logs.py` asserts exact coverage. Control: two 7-dimensional flats reach rank 8 (152 pairs).
- **Theorem 6 (PROVEN from the above).** The six multisets cannot occur; 8 independent qualifying directions are needed and at most 3 exist.
- **Consequences** (inherit #2816's reduction at cost 66; second, independent route via a Parity Lemma and a `d = 0` Carrier Lemma, both proved in the README): `Δ ≤ 2 ⇒ n_nf ≤ Δ` (decoder level) and `ρ_0 ≤ Δ` (lift level).
  - One-sided P112 decoders with `n_nf ≤ 3` non-full corrections (any number of full ones) cost **≥ 64**; in general corrected cost `= 64 + Δ − n_nf ≥ 67 − n_nf ≥ 59` (was `≥ 64` for `n_nf ≤ 2` and `≥ 66 − n_nf ≥ 58`).
  - Lift level: `cost_w(S) ≥ 64 + min(|I|, 3)` for every `S ⊇ 𝒞_{X_I}`; every lift of the E8 root code (E8/P120 decoder) costs **≥ 67**, and **≥ 72** unless the P112 restriction has `Δ ≥ 3`; gain-law form `|P120| − C(P120) ≤ 53`.

**Caveats**
- No κ claim, no supplier word. One-sided (case (b)) decoders of P112 only; not two-sided, not case (c), not other units, characteristic 0.
- `Δ ≥ n_nf` for general `n_nf` stays OPEN; the root-swap family of #2816 is tight at `n_nf ≤ 4`. An extension to `Δ = 3` is in progress and is neither claimed nor used.
- Inherited from #2816, cited and not recomputed: the DP/LP/Pencil/triple-rule survivor list (exactly these six at slack ≤ 2), the flat caps `g(1..7)`, `|Off| ≥ 53`, the circuit lemma.
- `verify.sh` (fresh export, `nice -n 10`, at most 6 processes, each under `timeout 1200`, no wait loops): data regeneration, Parity search, `s66.c` (modes 0, t and the 7+7 control), `indep.py` in both modes, then one PASS/FAIL line per assertion. TIMING_PLACEHOLDER
